fullPassage: Many crises today, such as the Great Recession, are simply too big and too overwhelming for you to completely comprehend, much less control. Crises of this ilk are precisely the kind that can easily engulf you with destructive reactions that interfere with your ability to overcome them. Focusing on these oversized crises will exacerbate the natural psychological, emotional, and physical reactions you are going to experience. With these sorts of crises, your best chance is to identify those aspects that are within your control. Then, you can break down the bigger crisis into smaller, more manageable problems toward which you can direct your energy and find solutions. For example, think back to the Great Recession. Although you probably didn't have the ability to influence economic policy, you were able to revisit the distribution of your investments and choose to create a more diverse portfolio.

Crises of this ilk are precisely the kind that can easily engulf you with destructive reactions that interfere with your ability to overcome them. Focusing on these oversized crises will exacerbate the natural psychological, emotional, and physical reactions you are going to experience. With these sorts of crises, your best chance is to identify those aspects that are within your control. Then, you can break down the bigger crisis into smaller, more manageable problems toward which you can direct your energy and find solutions. For example, think back to the Great Recession. Although you probably didn't have the ability to influence economic policy, you were able to revisit the distribution of your investments and choose to create a more diverse portfolio.

det.korean: 원문: didn't have the ability to influence economic policy. 할 수 없었던 것 = influence economic.
det.analysis: the ability to influence economic policy — 경제 정책에 영향을 미치는 것. 핵심단어 = influence economic.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 위기를 통제 가능한 부분으로 나누어 대처하라는 것이 핵심.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 투자 영향: 예시일 뿐 주제 아님
❌ ② 심리적 반응 완전 통제: 완전 통제가 아니라 관리 가능한 부분에 집중
✅ ③ 대규모 위기 → 작은 문제로 분해: 글의 핵심 전략 ←정답
❌ ④ 대공황 교훈: 예시일 뿐 주제 아님
det.tip: break down + identify within control = 핵심 전략

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 통제 가능한 부분에 집중 → 작은 문제로 분해 → 에너지와 해결책 투입.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 투자 전부 회수: 원문은 분배 재조정이지 회수가 아님
❌ ② 감정 무시: 원문은 반응 악화를 경고하지 무시하라고 안 함
❌ ③ 모든 위기 극복 가능: 원문은 too big to comprehend
✅ ④ 통제 가능한 부분에 집중: 핵심 요지 ←정답
det.tip: identify aspects within control → best chance

ch: 경제 위기 상황에서는 투자를 전부 회수해야 한다.
위기 상황에서 감정적 반응은 피할 수 없으므로 무시해야 한다.
모든 위기는 개인의 노력으로 충분히 극복 가능하다.
감당하기 어려운 위기는 통제 가능한 부분에 집중하여 대처해야 한다.
